title: Allocating Common-Value Goods
abstract: arXiv:2512.20001v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study a simple problem of allocating common-value goods. The designer seeks to allocate the goods to as many unit-demand agents as possible without monetary transfers, while agents, who possess partial private information about the goods, are willing to receive them only when the goods are of high value. Mechanisms screen each agent's private information using the information of other agents, and in doing so shape what agents learn from other agents about the value of the goods. The optimal mechanism can be summarized by two parameters: one adjusts the allocation probability, while the other governs the amount of learning induced by allocation. Although the designer prefers to allocate the goods, the optimal mechanism excludes some agents and, as a result, may withhold allocation even when all agents would be willing to receive them. translated_abstract: 我们研究了一个分配共同价值商品的简单问题。设计者希望在无货币转移的情况下，将商品分配给尽可能多的单位需求代理人，而代理人虽拥有关于商品的部分私人信息，但只有当商品具有高价值时才愿意接受商品。机制利用其他代理人的信息来筛选每个代理人的私人信息，并在此过程中塑造代理人从其他代理人处了解到的关于商品价值的信息。最优机制可以由两个参数概括：一个调节分配概率，另一个控制分配所引致的学习量。尽管设计者倾向于分配商品，但最优机制会排除某些代理人，因此即使所有代理人都愿意接受商品，机制也可能不予分配。即使在允许支付的情况下，最优机制仍具有相同的结构，但它可能不会排除……（摘要不完整）
tldr: 本文研究了无货币转移下分配共同价值商品的最优机制设计问题，证明最优机制可由分配概率和分配引致的学习量两个参数刻画，且最优机制会排除部分代理人，即使所有代理人都愿意接受商品也可能不予分配。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the optimal mechanism for allocating common-value goods without monetary transfers, showing it can be summarized by two parameters—allocation probability and induced learning—and that it may exclude some agents and withhold allocation even when all agents would willingly receive the goods.
